business_problem: Not only did these traditional methods struggle to scale, but they weren’t connected to the typical applications necessary within a modern work environment. One main objective was to transition away from the labor-intensive model of manually training HR directors and hiring managers to understand and implement their psychometric assessments.
solution_summary: Thomas’ central ethos has been that companies can elevate job satisfaction and productivity by better understanding how people interact with each other in the workplace. As they sought to expand and deepen their impact in the field of people science, Thomas encountered major roadblocks with traditional data management and utilization approaches. They turned to Databricks for help with improving their data workflows — from ingestion and transformation to analysis and solutions for customers and employees. Plus, the integration of GenAI through AI Search and retrieval augmented generation (RAG) further improved content searchability and automated content generation. The Databricks Data + AI Platform and Databricks tools enabled Thomas to improve their data workflows — from ingestion to transformation to analysis — all within a secure environment.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: AI Search
solution_components.role: Provides semantic retrieval over enterprise content for downstream generative AI experiences.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the conversational delivery channel for the data assistant experience.

data_flow: Operational, customer, and transactional data lands in Databricks, is transformed in the lakehouse, and is served to downstream users and applications through Microsoft Teams.
